text:
devin: reserving maintenance slot ms-1234 for txn-queue safe-migration + index backfill. start 2026-11-11T23:00:00Z. window=50m. plan: leader DDL, small phased backfills, and a quiesce step to drain txn queue before final wave. pin runtime to v2.20.0 during window.

deploybot: slot ms-1234 registered. start=2026-11-11T23:00:00Z window=50m owner=@devin holdpoints=[quiesce-drain, canary-green] autopause=12m

maya: quick canary: two tiny tenants on us-west, backfill-rate=400/s workers=4. monitoring: txn_queue_depth, wal_bytes, replication_lag p50/p99.

chao: abort triggers I'd like in thread: txn_queue_depth > 2000 sustained 90s OR wal_bytes > 1GB OR replication_lag > 60s for 3m. also abort if deadlocks > 1 in 5m.

devin: rollback TLDR for ops runbook:
```
- pause backfill: `./tools/migctl pause --slot ms-1234`
- flip write-block flag: `ff set tenant_txn_migration_block true`
- unpin runtime: `infractl pin api v2.19.7`
- revert DDL if safe: `psql -f revert/ms-1234-undo.sql`
- if revert fails: promote read-fallback and scale read replicas +2 for 8m
- notify: /msg #oncall "ms-1234 abort initiated"
```

ops-bot: reminder: add release-note draft at T-2h and attach expected RTO and affected tables.

maya: preflight checklist posted: staging smoke, sample pg_locks, txn_queue snapshot, schematest. smoke run T-30m.

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-1234.quiesce-drain. waiting for ACKs from @maya @chao. React with :white_check_mark: to continue.

chao: acked. running lock snapshot and txn_queue probe now. :white_check_mark:

maya: smoke OK. staging backfill 380/s, txn_queue avg 1200, wal_bytes < 200MB. canary ready.

deploybot: canary wave started. wave=1/4 targets=[t-13,t-14] workers=4 rate=400

devin: note: we will run a 90s quiesce to drain inflight transactions before the final schema swap. if txn_queue doesn't fall below 200 for 3m we abort.

maya: canary complete. metrics: errors=0.05% txn_queue_peak=1500 wal_bytes=210MB replication_peak=26s. vote CONTINUE or ABORT.

chao: +1 to continue but enable stricter txn_queue watch. set auto-abort if queue > 2000 for 90s.

ops-bot: alert policy: page on error_rate > 0.7% sustained 5m OR deadlocks >=2.

deploybot: wave=2/4 started. queued=9 workers=5 rate=600

maya: observed wal_bytes increase to 820MB during wave 2, still below 1GB. txn_queue oscillating near 1100. continuing with smaller batches for next wave.

chao: lowering next wave rate to 300 and increasing inter-wave gap to 10m to let WAL flush. also enabling pg_stat_wal monitor.

devin: running quiesce check T-5m before final wave. remind: capture `pg_stat_activity`, `pg_locks`, and txn_queue snapshots every 15s during quiesce.

deploybot: wave=3/4 complete. status=ok errors=0.13 replication_peak=38s wal_bytes=950MB

maya: starting quiesce now: stopping new backfill jobs and letting inflight transactions drain. current txn_queue=320.

chao: quiesce watch: txn_queue < 200 for 3m -> proceed; else -> abort and run rollback. monitoring logs to s3://redwood-runs/ms-1234/artifacts/

deploybot: quiesce complete and verified. txn_queue stable at 110. holdpoint ms-1234.canary-green created. please vote.

maya: +1 continue. :white_check_mark:

chao: +1 but keep abort thresholds active for 10m post-swap.

devin: executing final DDL and starting final backfill wave with conservative rate 250. will post release-note snippet to #release-notes: "ms-1234 txn-queue migration: leader DDL + staggered backfills; runtime pinned to v2.20.0 during window; rollback steps in ops-runbook."

deploybot: final wave started. wave=4/4 queued=3 workers=4 rate=250

ops-bot: auto-archive: attach deploybot.audit id ddb-3712345678 and upload run artifacts when slot closes.

devin: final status: slot ms-1234 complete. aggregate errors=0.17% replication_peak=44s wal_bytes_final=980MB. logs: s3://redwood-runs/ms-1234/. will open follow-up for WAL tuning and batch heuristics. closing thread. :rocket:
